title: European Research Council's €10 million positive-geometries initiative

tellings.quote: It's so big now that the European Research Council has a 10 million euro initiative.

plain: A line of physics research called positive geometries, linked to the physicist Nima Arkani-Hamed, has grown so large that the European Research Council has put 10 million euros into an initiative on it. That is according to a scientist named Donald Hoffman, who argues that our brains evolved to hide reality from us. He says it on the show in passing, without naming a source, as a sign that the ideas behind his view are being taken seriously.
